_doc: Reviewed attribute overrides by canonical name (E1.3, revised the same day). Priority over the keyword rules of enrich_catalog.py. FACT vs BEHAVIOUR: `contains_lactose` is a nutritional fact (whey concentrate, cheese, yogurt and curd DO contain lactose); how the trainer treats lactose-intolerant clients is a BEHAVIOUR recorded as a rule in validated_rules.json (section 8, empirical support n=17, low confidence), not as a food attribute. This lets the validator run in two modes: reproduce the professional's criterion, or apply the restriction strictly.

leche.reason: fact; empirically never given to the 17 declared-intolerant clients

queso.reason: fact (cured cheeses: trace amounts; kept true, declared)

batido de proteínas.reason: fact: whey concentrate contains lactose; unknown brands -> true

proteína aislada.reason: fact: whey isolate is below the lactose threshold (defensible factually)

caseína.reason: milk protein; residual lactose -> conservative true

postre o dulce.reason: natillas / flan / arroz con leche -> conservative true

miel.reason: honey is not processed sugar by the definition of the flag; the corpus evidence (3 items, 2 clients, 0 notes) is INSUFFICIENT to conclude whether the trainer allows or forbids it

refresco light.reason: no sugar; forbidden through the 'bebidas con gas / con sabor' clause (is_soft_drink)

embutido.reason: some contain gluten as filler; conservative, consistent with avena

avena.reason: explicit conservative decision: cross-contamination and avenin reactivity

legumbres.reason: CARB primary (trainer's dinner rule), PROTEIN secondary

infusión.reason: herbal infusions do not break the fast

sinefrina.reason: stimulant supplement kept in the catalogue; flagged for the explainability panel

melatonina.reason: kept as SUPPLEMENT (OTC <= 1.9 mg in Spain, not ergogenic); declared in the report

pan sin gluten.reason: gluten-free by definition, same criterion as «leche sin lactosa». El profesional prescribe «Pan Integral sin gluten» y «Pasta integral sin gluten» a sus celiacos: 17 componentes en 9 dietas. Con un unico canonico «pan integral» marcado con gluten, el validador se los quitaba -- correctamente, porque la restriccion dura no se relaja NUNCA -- y el cliente se quedaba sin la fuente de hidratos que su propio preparador le habia escrito. El defecto no estaba en la restriccion sino en el catalogo: el pan sin gluten es otro alimento.
